definitions.explanation: A painting or pictorial work executed directly on a wall, whether ancient cave art, religious imagery in temples, or modern street murals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁画|へきが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited some ancient wall paintings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁画|へきが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}かれた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The murals in this temple were painted in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧な{壁画|へきが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いている→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Young artists are painting a giant mural on the building in front of the station.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (wall) + {画|が} (picture). Covers everything from prehistoric cave paintings to modern street art.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁画|へきが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to paint a mural
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁画|へきが}: ancient wall painting
- {壁画|へきが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修復|しゅうふく}→修復：11544_shuufuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restore a mural
- ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁画|へきが}: temple mural

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧: painting — general term for paintings on any surface, especially canvas
- {天井画|てんじょうが}: ceiling painting — painting on a ceiling rather than a wall
